citation: UNEP-WCMC and IUCN (2026), Protected Planet: The World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) and World Database on Other Effective Area-based Conservation Measures (WD-OECM) [Online], October 2026, Cambridge, UK: UNEP-WCMC and IUCN. Available at: www.protectedplanet.net.

rules.mab: UNESCO-MAB Biosphere Reserve records kept in the protected-area layer, counted
rules.dissolve: union per layer, split into connected parts (the features)
rules.domain: whole polygons that intersect the domain (as a8_emergence.polygon_layers)

wdpa_protected_areas.what: protected areas (WDPA, every designated protected-area polygon; dissolved)

wdpa_ramsar.what: Ramsar sites (WDPA international designation; polygons; dissolved)

wdpa_protected_areas_noksrz.what: protected areas without the Kazakh State Reserved Zone in the northern Caspian (sensitivity, D-103 addendum; dissolved)
